transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I've just been feeling completely empty and depressed for about a year now. I've lost all interest in the things I used to enjoy, and I just can't find the motivation to do anything anymore.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?
I'm really not sure what triggered it, to be honest. It just seemed to start on its own without any clear cause, and it's been like this for the past year.
Before this past year, had you been feeling down most days for at least two years, or is this the first long depressive period you’ve had?
No, this is the first time I've ever felt like this. I didn't have a two-year period of feeling down before this started. It has really just been this past year that everything has been like this.
During this past year, have you also had changes in your sleep or appetite, low energy, trouble concentrating, or feelings of worthlessness or guilt?

Yes, I've been struggling heavily with my concentration, to the point where I can't even focus on watching TV or reading anymore. I also constantly feel completely worthless and carry this heavy, nonstop guilt. My sleep, appetite, and energy levels haven't really changed much, though.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?

Yes, I often feel like life isn't worth living and wish I just wouldn't wake up in the morning. I have recurring thoughts of wanting to die, and sometimes I get these sudden, scary impulses to hurt myself, though I try my best to resist them.
Have you made any plans to kill yourself, or taken any steps toward hurting yourself?

I... I have, yes. I've been saving up my prescription pills in my drawer, and I actually wrote a goodbye letter to my family last week. I've thought about exactly how and when to do it... it just feels like the only way out.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energized or euphoric, needed much less sleep, or were more impulsive than usual?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never had periods of high energy or feeling on top of the world; mostly, I've just felt really low and depressed.
